legacy_regressions: No rule or historical contract changed beyond the two fixes
limits: Full-chain regression uses synthetic records and images; no new artwork produced under 0.2.20.2
Automatic checks are model judgments, not human approval
promotion_basis: Verified candidate runtime with documented distribution cleanup; publication only after explicit user authorization.
